item.title: No Rape If Marriage Promise Fails After Consensual Relationship, Says Uttarakhand High Court
item.description: In a significant judgment, the Uttarakhand High Court has ruled that a failed promise of marriage following a long term consensual relationship between two adults cannot automatically be treated as rape under Section 376 of the IPC unless it is shown that the promise was false from the very beginning.
